# Immobiliare & GrowthBook | Setup moving forward
Date: 2026-10-28 | Duration: 25.299999237060547m

## Summary
GrowthBook is currently used for A/B testing, percentage-based feature rollouts, feature flags, and B2B and B2C configurations. Live experiments include checkout funnel and buyer-button variants, with GrowthBook allocating traffic and Mixpanel analyzing behavioral results. Buyer-focused evaluation centers on lead-generation metrics such as saved searches, listing views, and saved listings, while seller-focused evaluation emphasizes publishing funnels, private-seller checkout, and revenue. The Pro plan remains sufficient because it includes unlimited experiments without traffic or active-user charges. Enterprise adds SSO, provisioning, enhanced support, training, onboarding, contextual bandits, post-stratification, and AI features. An upgrade was deferred because there was no immediate strong reason, although future needs and budgeting may change. A two-week Enterprise trial was offered, and Marcel will send a recap, Enterprise information deck, and product capability documentation, including details on the Learnings AI assistant, MCP server documentation, and updated Visual Editor.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, A/B testing, Feature flags, Mixpanel, Enterprise plan, AI experimentation
